title: OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin)
tagline: The open-source AI platform for software development, debugging, and terminal operations
summary: Full autonomous coding platform executing bash, editing code files, and running browser tests in Docker.
description_markdown:
### What is OpenHands?
OpenHands is a community-driven AI software engineering agent capable of writing code, debugging issues, running bash terminal commands, and interacting with web browsers to verify web UI changes.

### Autonomous Capabilities
- **Long-Horizon Planning**: Deconstructs repository-level GitHub issues into modular implementation steps.
- **Sandbox Execution**: Operates inside an isolated Docker container with direct access to compiler, linters, and package managers.
- **Browser Verification**: Automatically opens Chrome instances to inspect frontend regressions.

### Terminal Setup
```bash
docker run -it --pull=always \
  -e SANDBOX_USER_ID=$(id -u) \
  -e LLM_API_KEY="$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
  -e LLM_MODEL="anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet" \
  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  docker.all-hands.dev/all-hands-ai/runtime:0.14-nikola
```

### Architectural Strengths & Known Edge Cases
- **Strengths**: Strict sandbox isolation; full native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support; active open-source contributor ecosystem.
- **Edge Cases**: High token usage during broad directory indexing passes; requires Docker daemon socket access.
hardware_requirements: 8 GB RAM, Docker Desktop or Linux Docker Engine with GPU optional
strengths: Full terminal, editor, and browser execution loop
Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration
known_edge_cases: Token-heavy on large repos without selective indexing

title: Devin AI
tagline: The first autonomous AI software engineer designed to collaborate with human engineering teams
summary: Autonomous cloud software engineer with its own sandboxed shell, code editor, and browser.
description_markdown:
### What is Devin?
Devin is an autonomous software engineering assistant built by Cognition. Devin manages complex engineering projects end-to-end, solving real-world GitHub issues, deploying web apps, and diagnosing obscure build failures.

### Autonomous Capabilities
- **End-to-End Planning**: Builds dependency graphs, installs missing system packages, and self-corrects on unit test failures.
- **Interactive Browser Sandbox**: Tests web applications against dynamic user workflows.

### Setup Sequence
Devin operates as a managed Cloud SaaS workspace. Teams integrate Devin via GitHub App authorization or enterprise API keys.

### Architectural Strengths & Known Edge Cases
- **Strengths**: Highest benchmark accuracy on SWE-bench; seamless GitHub PR generation; managed cloud environment requiring zero local setup.
- **Edge Cases**: Closed-source proprietary models; commercial enterprise subscription model.
strengths: Automated pull request creation and CI monitoring
known_edge_cases: Proprietary cloud SaaS without on-premise offline hosting

title: Stagehand (Browserbase)
tagline: The AI web browsing framework built for resilient, autonomous browser workflows
summary: Modular browser automation agent powered by Playwright with autonomous visual DOM healing and extraction.
description_markdown:
### What is Stagehand?
Stagehand is an open-source web automation framework built on top of Playwright. It replaces brittle XPath and CSS selectors with LLM-powered semantic actions (`act()`, `extract()`, `observe()`).

### Autonomous Capabilities
- **Self-Healing Selectors**: Adapts to DOM structure updates, A/B tests, and layout refactors automatically.
- **Structured Extraction**: Extracts validated Zod schemas directly from live browser sessions.

### Terminal Setup
```bash
npm install @browserbase/stagehand
npx stagehand init
```

### Architectural Strengths & Known Edge Cases
- **Strengths**: Extremely fast execution; zero flaky selector maintenance; native TypeScript & Playwright synergy.
- **Edge Cases**: Sensitive to heavy anti-bot Cloudflare challenges if run locally without proxy rotation.
strengths: Self-healing actions resilient to website redesigns
Type-safe data extraction with Zod schemas
Built natively on standard Playwright primitives
known_edge_cases: Can consume excessive tokens on infinite scroll DOMs
Requires browser proxy routing for strict CAPTCHA sites

title: Browser-Use
tagline: Connect AI agents directly with web browsers to automate any web workflow
summary: Lightweight Python library enabling autonomous agent control over Chromium browser sessions with vision.
description_markdown:
### What is Browser-Use?
Browser-Use connects LLMs directly to browser sessions. It provides agents with interactive mouse, keyboard, and DOM vision capabilities to fill forms, research products, and extract deep web data.

### Autonomous Capabilities
- **Multi-Step Form Filling**: Navigates multi-page checkout and auth flows without hardcoded scripts.
- **Visual Element Recognition**: Identifies interactive components via labeled bounding boxes overlaid onto screenshots.

### Terminal Setup
```bash
pip install browser-use playwright
playwright install
python -c "from browser_use import Agent; ..."
```
terminal_setup_script: pip install browser-use playwright && playwright install
strengths: High visual grounding accuracy on complex web apps
Seamless integration with local Ollama vision models
known_edge_cases: Can get trapped in endless pagination loops without max_steps guard
Vision token overhead per screenshot step

title: GPT Researcher
tagline: Autonomous agent for in-depth research across web pages, academic PDFs, and reports
summary: Multi-agent research engine that reads 20+ sources concurrently and produces cited technical reports.
description_markdown:
### What is GPT Researcher?
GPT Researcher is an autonomous agent designed for comprehensive online research. By parallelizing web scraping across sub-agents, it filters out misinformation, aggregates citations, and compiles authoritative research reports.

### Autonomous Capabilities
- **Parallel Crawler Swarms**: Dispatches worker agents to ingest twenty distinct web sources concurrently.
- **Contextual Synthesis**: Resolves conflicting data points across sources and generates markdown documents with APA-style citations.

### Terminal Setup
```bash
git clone https://github.com/assafelovic/gpt-researcher.git
cd gpt-researcher
pip install -r requirements.txt
export OPENAI_API_KEY="your_key"
python main.py
```
strengths: Rigorous multi-source verification and hallucination reduction
known_edge_cases: Requires third-party search API key (e.g. Tavily, SerpAPI)
High rate of token consumption for multi-page PDF synthesis

title: CrewAI
tagline: Framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous AI agents to tackle complex workflows
summary: Collaborative multi-agent framework organizing specialized AI agents with role definitions and delegation.
description_markdown:
### What is CrewAI?
CrewAI enables software developers to build multi-agent teams where individual agents have distinct roles, goals, and backstories. Agents can delegate subtasks, execute tools, and share memory to achieve high-order goals.

### Autonomous Capabilities
- **Role-Based Collaboration**: Agents autonomously pass context to peers with relevant specializations.
- **Sequential and Hierarchical Execution**: Supports manager agents orchestrating subordinate teams.

### Terminal Setup
```bash
pip install crewai crewai-tools
crewai create crew my_project
```
strengths: Comprehensive built-in tool library (web, scrapers, DBs)
known_edge_cases: Can descend into recursive delegation cycles without explicit max_rpm limits
Debugging inter-agent chatter requires external tracing
